name: Toxic Test
label: Quest
description: Toxic Test: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose. The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive. Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.
Take this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur. The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to pacify the great beast?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. You are brave and wise.
Tell me, how did the devilsaur react to the toxin?
